integrity: Analytic spherical geometry plus a complete exact ordered-field arrangement enumeration; numerical decimals are illustrative. External independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
limitations: Only central planar sections of a three-dimensional regular dodecahedron under spherical Haar sampling; not affine offsets, perturbed solids or alternative measures. Historical priority remains subject to older stereological/projection literature.
title: Exact Haar section-type probabilities of the regular dodecahedron
